title: Show drummer or jazz drummer
summary: His forte was show work, but drummers of his generation had to do both; today it is specialists.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, do you consider yourself more a show drummer than a jazz drummer, or -- that's sort of a stupid question, but --

Well, no, but I'd like to consider myself, but now and then it's not true, I'd like to consider myself a jazz drummer. But, I mean, that's not true. My forte was the show work. And then -- but just like I say, in those days and in coming up and all of that, you were a little of everything. You had to be a decent jazz drummer. You had to be a decent show drummer.
Yeah, if you were a professional
musician, you did what you were asked to do.
Right, right, right, whatever the order was,yeah. That was good, --
Right, right, but, see, and then in later years, it's specialists. Everything's specialists, yeah, right, right. Yeah, so you hire a guy according to his ability, special ability.
